brief:
The United Nations on Friday urged Costa Rica to reverse its ban on admitting the UN special rapporteur on Palestinian rights, Al-Monitor reported. The appeal came after Costa Rica blocked entry to the rapporteur, whose mandate includes investigating human rights concerns affecting Palestinians.

The UN's call represents an attempt to restore access for the independent expert, whose role requires field visits to assess alleged violations and report to the international body.
dek: The United Nations on Friday urged Costa Rica to urgently reconsider its ban on admitting the UN special rapporteur on Palestinian rights and let her into the country.
title: UN presses Costa Rica to admit Palestinian rights rapporteur
